scope: Init-only nominal 32768 Hz LSE SYSCLK on exactly five CW32L083 packages using the existing board-qualified Config.lse tuple. Preserve all 23 auxiliary-LSE and eleven earlier LSE SYSCLK qualifications; no family alias, LSI SYSCLK, runtime switching, wake or recovery qualification.
hardware_count_source: Own CN manual V2.0 PDF65/printed64 and PDF76/printed75: failure below 128 LSE edges during 256 LSI clocks; LSECCS requires LSIEN.
margin_source: Sufficient software condition 256 * minimum_LSE_hz > (128 + 1) * 33784 with u64 products. 17023 Hz fails; 17024 Hz passes the inequality only. The complete board envelope must contain 32768 Hz. The extra edge is software margin, not a hardware threshold or a per-cycle LSI guarantee.

fallback.basis: Own manual PDF65/76 names a switch to HSI and PDF75/78 gives normal HSI DIV. These claims do not promise fault-side divisor retention or a divisor rewrite. New LSE SYSCLK admission therefore covers factory HSI48MHz +2% at effective HSI/AHB/APB divisors 1, without asserting hardware resets any divisor. Existing direct-HSE and L052 fixed-/6 policy are unchanged.

hsi_register.update_policy: Stopped trim writes preserve DIV/reserved bits. Live divider-only changes preserve TRIM/reserved bits under the own section4.5.2 procedure.

transition_policy: Before source mutation perform native AUTOTRIM, retained-owner and contradictory LSI/detector admission. Install WAIT2 with readback, enable independently legal unchanged HSI, then the first CR0 write selects ready unchanged HSI plus monotonic AHB/APB guards. Stop inherited PLL and observe PLLEN=0 and PLL.STABLE=0 while preserving its reference. Prepare factory LSI with the existing complete two-pass stopped-LSI guard on mismatch. Retrim HSI only on a private LSI bridge after PLL stop; live DIV-only writes preserve TRIM. Preserve enabled HSE parameters/pads. Start or exactly reuse LSE with factory LSI/LSECCS retained. Prove configured factory HSI at final AHB/APB, install final divisors explicitly under HSI, then select LSE once. No CR0 write after final selection; retain WAIT2 through final tree/pad/source acknowledgment and publication.
native_admission_policy: Own L083 has one DRIVER/AMP bank, no PDRIVER/PAMP and a real PLL. Retain the own complete RTC reset roster and gate-preserving RTC/UART1..6/AUTOTRIM/LPTIM/LCD/LVD/output ownership mechanisms. Preserve native flags, reservations, enabled sources and policy on failure; do not reset, clear, unlock or sanitize an unadmitted tree.
source_tuple: The same board Config.lse tuple supplies intended LSE SYSCLK/HCLK/PCLK and later LseClock/RTC. Factory monitor and fallback headroom do not replace the board per-cycle bounds or establish peripheral timing after a source loss.
limits: No guaranteed crystal startup completion time
No guarantee of CPU progress or bounded loss-to-fallback time
No frozen-clock validity or RTC continuity after source loss/fallback
No runtime switching, low-power wake, arbitrary handover sanitization or silicon validation
